title: auth/store.rs: timing-safe unknown-user verification correctly defended
description: CredentialStore.check always runs bcrypt::verify against either the real hash or a precomputed dummy hash at the same cost factor. The dummy hash is computed at startup from the actual configured hashes' cost factor, not a hardcoded constant. This correctly prevents both the username-existence timing oracle and the cost-mismatch timing oracle. A future contributor might suggest short-circuiting to return false early for unknown users to 'save CPU' — this would reintroduce the timing oracle and must be rejected.
